home.heroBody: Playful lessons with a live simulation: instead of memorizing a formula, grab a handle and watch it happen — an integral born from plain rectangles, a derivative born from a tangent line.
home.curriculumNote: Lessons are matched to topics from Israel's official 5-unit math curriculum — a study aid, not a certified prep course.
